name: CIE Automotive
why: Working capital healthy - debtor days 26 to 24, inventory days 85 to 86 (not rising)
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Good (sales +11% YoY, profit +14% YoY)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 127% of 3-year profit
risks: Not at record: quarterly profit, annual profit
Margins shrinking (15% to 14%) - record profit may be near peak
Thin order book: only 0.1x annual sales
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 85% to 86% of sales)
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: Ander Alvarez: The order book in Q3 was, let's say, quite healthy, and we got INR9.7 billion total in -- year- to-date 9 months, INR9.7 billion of new orders in all the verticals in India, and approximately INR3 billion
So that's the order book that we have already consolidated in this year -- this calendar year '26.
capex: In CY26, the overall capex in India will be almost double of last year.
Our Stampings division is planning expansion at multiple locations to meet the expectation of its 2 main customers.
risks: The margin drop is due to price pressures generated by the conflict in West Asia, mainly in raw material, energy and consumables.
We had a delay in the SOP of approximately 6 months, mainly due to the customer-driven delay, not our responsibility.
focus: The Aluminum division is planning to diversify into 4-wheeler HPDC parts, and this will require new lines.
So there is a balance in new market share on the EVs versus the ICE.

Of course, we are entering into certain EV components in our forging divisions but the volumes and, let's say, the turnover of these components are much lower than the crankshaft value because of the weights are lower.
